verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own case management lets analysts select a case decision ('no risk detected', 'risk detected- accepted', 'risk detected- offboard'), and a case audit-trail endpoint returns the history of a case, so decisions are recorded in an investigation history. Nothing in the pack shows analysts can add free-text notes, attach evidence, or record a decision rationale beyond the decision category. missing for 10: documented free-text notes or comments on cases, evidence or file attachments, a documented decision-reason field, confirmation that these entries appear in the audit trail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can record evidence, notes and decision reasons in the investigation history

citations.quote: They can then select a case decision of ‘no risk detected’, ‘risk detected- accepted’ and ‘risk detected- offboard’.
Returns the audit log trail for a case.
Its case management solution allows you to prioritise and review risk alerts raised during onboarding and ongoing monitoring.
